exposure: Low amniotic fluid index (AFI) of = 5 cm
cohort: 100 pregnant women with low amniotic fluid index (AFI) of = 5 cm with term pregnancy without high risk factor
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of cardiotocography changes, rate of C-section, staining of meconium, apgar score at five minutes, admission to neonatal unit and perinatal death between females with low AFI and those with normal AFI.
